key_insight: Stochastic transport models connect uncertainty-aware geophysical fluid dynamics with rigorous analysis, data-driven calibration and high-dimensional Bayesian inference.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports uncertainty quantification and forecasting in ocean and other geophysical flow applications.
method: Establish well-posedness, regularity and approximation theory for stochastic transport.
Calibrate stochastic transport structures using observations and high-resolution simulations.
Apply Bayesian data assimilation, particle filters and machine learning uncertainty quantification.
evidence_signal: The abstract synthesizes theoretical and methodological developments and identifies calibration data sources, but reports no quantitative evaluation results.
watch_item: Practical adoption requires assessing calibration quality and computational scalability for high-dimensional geophysical systems.
paper_title: From Stochastic Transport Models to High-Dimensional Bayesian Inference
